arxiv-2108-06731.title: The centralizers of root subgroups in Kac—Moody Steinberg groups
arxiv-2108-06731.creator: Andrei Smolensky
arxiv-2108-06731.description: Abstract For the affine and hyperbolic root system the symmetric part of the centralizers of root subgroups in the corresponding Steinberg groups are calculated. In the affine case the corresponding root subsystems can be computed in term of the centralizers in the spherical root systems, while in the hyperbolic case there emerges a “zoo” of examples, many of them non-hyperbolic.

arxiv-2202-12124.title: Projected gradient-tracking in multi-cluster games and its application to power management Thanks:
arxiv-2202-12124.creator: Jan Zimmermann, Tatiana Tatarenko, Volker Willert, Jürgen Adamy
arxiv-2202-12124.description: Abstract We are concerned with a distributed approach to solve multi-cluster games arising in multi-agent systems. In such games, agents are separated into distinct clusters. The agents belonging to the same cluster cooperate with each other to achieve a common cluster goal while a non-cooperative game is played between the clusters.

arxiv-2305-14821.title: Emerging solutions from the battle of defensive alliances
arxiv-2305-14821.creator: Attila Szolnoki, Xiaojie Chen
arxiv-2305-14821.description: Abstract Competing strategies in an evolutionary game model, or species in a biosystem, can easily form a larger unit which protects them from the invasion of an external actor. Such a defensive alliance may have two, three, four or even more members. But how effective can be such formation against an alternative group composed by other competitors?

arxiv-2311-00557.description: Abstract It was recently found that the indefinite causal order in the quantum switch can be certified device-independently when assuming the impossibility of superluminal influences. arxiv-2405-13636.title: Audio Mamba: Pretrained Audio State Space Model For Audio Tagging
arxiv-2405-13636.creator: Jiaju Lin, Haoxuan Hu
arxiv-2405-13636.description: Abstract Audio tagging is an important task of mapping audio samples to their corresponding categories. Recently endeavours that exploit transformer models in this field have achieved great success. However, the quadratic self-attention cost limits the scaling of audio transformer models and further constrains the development of more universal audio models.

arxiv-2407-02140.title: Mixing automorphisms not having the Kolmogorov spectral property
arxiv-2407-02140.creator: Valery V. Ryzhikov
arxiv-2407-02140.description: Abstract Abstract. Let T be a staircase rank-one construction with parameters r_{j}\sim j^{d} , 0<d<0.2 , then its spectrum does not have the group property, and the product T\odot T has simple spectrum. 1 Introduction Long ago Kolmogorov conjectured (see, for example, [ 1 ] ) that the maximum spectral type of an ergodic automorphism always subordinates its convolution.

arxiv-2409-01046.title: Accelerated Multi-objective Task Learning using Modified Q Q -learning Algorithm
arxiv-2409-01046.creator: Varun Prakash Rajamohan, Senthil Kumar Jagatheesaperumal
arxiv-2409-01046.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Varun Prakash Rajamohan, Senthil Kumar Jagatheesaperumal. Robots find extensive applications in industry. In recent years, the influence of robots has also increased rapidly in domestic scenarios. The Q-learning algorithm aims to maximise the reward for reaching the goal. This paper proposes a modified version of the Q Q -learning algorithm, known as Q Q -learning with scaled distance metric ( Q − S ​ D Q-SD ). This algorithm enhances task learning and makes task completion more meaningful.

arxiv-2409-15533.title: Switching of magnetic domains in a noncollinear antiferromagnet at the nanoscale
arxiv-2409-15533.creator: Atul Pandey, Prajwal Rigvedi, Edouard Lesne, Jitul Deka, Jiho Yoon, Wolfgang Hoppe, Chris Koerner, Banabir Pal, James M. Taylor, Stuart S. P. Parkin, Georg Woltersdorf
arxiv-2409-15533.description: Abstract Antiferromagnets that display very small stray magnetic field are ideal for spintronic applications. Of particular interest are non-collinear, chiral antiferromagnets of the type Mn 3 ​ X \mathrm{Mn_{3}X} (X=Sn, Ge), which display a large magnetotransport response that is correlated with their antiferromagnetic ordering.

arxiv-2503-17064.title: The inconvenient truth about flocks
arxiv-2503-17064.creator: Leiming Chen, Patrick Jentsch, Chiu Fan Lee, Ananyo Maitra, Sriram Ramaswamy, John Toner
arxiv-2503-17064.description: Abstract We reanalyze the hydrodynamic theory of “flocks” that is, polar ordered “dry” active fluids in two dimensions. For “Malthusian” flocks, in which birth and death cause the density to relax quickly, thereby eliminating density as a hydrodynamic variable, we are able to obtain two exact scaling laws relating the three scaling exponents characterizing the long-distance properties of these systems.

arxiv-2510-09294.title: Mitigating Model Drift in Developing Economies using Synthetic Data and Outliers
arxiv-2510-09294.creator: Ilyas Varshavskiy, Bonu Boboeva, Shuhrat Khalilbekov, Azizjon Azimi, Sergey Shulgin, Akhlitdin Nizamitdinov, Haitz Sáez de Ocáriz Borde
arxiv-2510-09294.description: Abstract Machine learning models in finance are highly susceptible to model drift, where predictive performance declines as data distributions shift. This issue is especially acute in developing economies such as those in Central Asia and the Caucasus—including Tajikistan, Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, and Azerbaijan—where frequent and unpredictable macroeconomic shocks destabilize financial data.

pmc-10571890.title: Hydrocortisone Mitigates Alzheimer’s-Related Cognitive Decline through Modulating Oxidative Stress and Neuroinflammation
pmc-10571890.creator: Jinran Li, Long Chen, Sai Liu, Yuan Sun, Le Zhen, Zheying Zhu, Guangji Wang, Xinuo Li, Maurizio Romano
pmc-10571890.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Alzheimer’s disease (AD), an age-related degenerative disorder, is characterized by β-amyloid deposition, abnormal phosphorylation of tau proteins, synaptic dysfunction, neuroinflammation, and oxidative stress. Despite extensive research, there are no medications or therapeutic interventions to completely treat and reverse AD. Herein, we explore the potential of hydrocortisone (HC), a natural and endogenous glucocorticoid known to have potent anti-inflammatory properties, in an Aβ1–42-induced AD mouse model.

pmc-11411821.creator: Ruijie Shan, Zhenhui Wang, Chenjuan Ma, Chunhong Guo, Naixue Cui
pmc-11411821.description: BackgroundIn China, Internet-Based Sharing Nursing Service (IBSNS) is a new mode of nursing service delivery that has been in practice for over five years, which enables nurses to provide care at clients’ home. However, the acceptance and associated factors of IBSNS among caregivers of elderly with chronic diseases who are the major clients of the service were unclear.

pmc-11499656.title: Accurate prediction of drug-target interactions in Chinese and western medicine by the CWI-DTI model
pmc-11499656.creator: Ying Li, Xingyu Zhang, Zhuo Chen, Hongye Yang, Yuhui Liu, Huiqing Wang, Ting Yan, Jie Xiang, Bin Wang
pmc-11499656.description: Accurate prediction of drug-target interactions (DTIs) is crucial for advancing drug discovery and repurposing. Computational methods have significantly improved the efficiency of experimental predictions for drug-target interactions in Western medicine. However, accurately predicting the complex relationships between Chinese medicine ingredients and targets remains a formidable challenge due to the vast number and high heterogeneity of these ingredients.

pmc-11628948.title: Cost-effectiveness of long-acting progestogens versus the combined oral contraceptives pill for preventing recurrence of endometriosis-related pain following surgery: an economic evaluation alongside the PRE-EMPT trial
pmc-11628948.creator: Melyda Melyda, Mark Monahan, Kevin G Cooper, Siladitya Bhattacharya, Jane P Daniels, Versha Cheed, Lee Middleton, Tracy E Roberts
pmc-11628948.description: ObjectivesTo evaluate the cost-effectiveness of long-acting progestogens (LAP), including levonorgestrel-releasing intrauterine system (LNG-IUS) and depot-medroxyprogesterone acetate (DMPA), compared with the combined oral contraceptives pill (COCP) in preventing recurrence of endometriosis-related pain postsurgery.DesignWithin-trial economic evaluation alongside a multicentre, pragmatic, parallel-group, open-label, randomised controlled trial (Preventing Recurrence of Endometriosis by means of Long-Acting Progestogen Therapy trial).

pmc-12523059.title: Effects of exercise alone or combined with dietary restriction on leptin and adiponectin in overweight or obese individuals: a network meta-analysis
pmc-12523059.creator: Xianyang Xin, Yongqing Guo, Longyan Liu, Qinzheng Liu, Jun Xie
pmc-12523059.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to evaluate the effects and ranking of different exercise modalities, with or without dietary restriction, on adipokine levels (leptin and adiponectin) in overweight and obese individuals. Additionally, the independent contribution of dietary restriction to adipokine level improvement was analyzed.

pmc-13149050.creator: Seung Sik Yoo, Sun Mi Gu, Kyung Tak Nam, Jeong Soon Choi, Yong Sun Lee, In Jun Yeo, Ji Eun Yu, Sanghyeon Kim, Dong Won Lee, Hyeon Joo Ham, Ju Young Chang, Jaesuk Yun, Dong Ju Son, Sang-Bae Han, Jin Tae Hong
pmc-13149050.description: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is characterized by progressive cognitive deterioration and significant depression. However, the mechanisms linking depression to AD pathology remain unclear. Here, we investigated whether Notch2 signaling mediates depression-like behaviors in presenilin-2 (PS2) N141I mutant mice, an early-onset AD model.
